findings.title: Taylorville Family Medicine Closing After 26 Years of Practice
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Taylorville Family Medicine is closing after 26 years, the Highway 69 South practice announced on Facebook Monday.
findings.service_line: Primary care / family medicine (Taylorville Family Medicine, Highway 69 South)
findings.access_consequences: Local report says the family-medicine practice is closing after 26 years. Closure date, operational status, patient numbers, and continuity/referral plans could not be verified from the accessible excerpt; no currently effective closure is asserted.
findings.affected_population: Existing Taylorville Family Medicine primary-care patients; number unknown.

cms_public_notices.result: Official CMS Public Notices inspected before targeted searches. No newly dated CMS provider termination, rescission, CLIA limitation/suspension, or analogous access notice in the recall interval.

source_failures.detail: Two direct web opens timed out. Local news search excerpt was available and preserved verbatim; article-specific effective date and patient transition could not be verified.
Known persistent Health First official alert endpoint access error; rechecked. Other official and search coverage remained usable.
Attempted an outdated CMS URL; resolved and successfully opened the correct CMS Public Notices page before conducting targeted searches.

coverage_notes.quality_limitations: Bounded supplementary web recall is not comprehensive. Search snippet and date-only news entry establish reported closure but not exact article first-publication time, effective date, patient impact, or whether production has already captured it. The announcement itself predates the hour. Flag for review, not approval or publication.
coverage_notes.controls: No approval, publication, production change, schedule change, or task disabling.
